NRCS operates and provisions the NASIS database/web services from which this delivery was exported (mn-nasis-export_logFile.txt; tcms-nasis.shp.xml). Organization-level assignment; dataset-level (applies across releases).

The underlying pedon/site field descriptions and lab data in NASIS were collected over decades by NRCS and NCSS-cooperating soil scientists as part of the National Cooperative Soil Survey program; NASIS's own pedon schema (NCSS Pedon Schema 7.4.1) and the site/pedon record structure are NRCS/NCSS standards. This is an organization-level assignment for the underlying field investigation as a whole; it has NOT been resolved to individual field describers (the pedon table's 'descname' field contains individual describer names per tcms-nasis.shp.xml, and NASIS cooperators are not limited to NRCS staff, e.g. university/state partners may also be represented) -- see REVIEW-QUESTIONS.txt.

DNR's Minnesota Biological Survey (MBS) program maintains and distributes the Relevé Database from which this export was drawn (raw/ancillary information/DNR Releve Data Use Agreement_2013.doc). Organization-level assignment; dataset-level.
